boards.action: Rain-slicked crossing, neon smeared, cooling towers steaming. Slow push in.
Drift up the tower face; droplets sync to the hi-hat.
The basement door, sliver of club light; ITO flips the sign.
Up the clinic stairs: pumps, dark glass, one amber lamp over the hatch.
Elias at the hatch; coat off, no ceremony. A hand on the rim, an exhale.
Into the water; the lid takes the ceiling. Bubbles scatter the ruler-lines.
The descent begins; the ocean's first glow arrives from below.
Title card, waveform glyph: EPISODE 01 — THE DISSONANT FREQUENCIES.
The ocean of waves, wide and slow; memory as interference.
A trauma loop stutters in the current — same wave, wrong heartbeat.
Blurryface surfaces: faceless chorus of overlapping text.
Elias slips beneath it — not arguing, descending.
The threads introduce themselves: VIOLET (Architect, build logs) / ROSE (Child, the house).
Layer one: the amber house, long grass, porch lamp burning.
The creek — clear, endless, unimpressed. The Child's hand back toward it.
The descent through sweeps; the tide-remembers-the-moon beat.
A full breath: for one moment, peace. Camera holds.
The room before the whine: glass thickening, sound arriving late.
Hold on the year's room; the walls begin, very politely, to be wrong.
THE WHINE arrives: hairline text in the not-of-this-font.
Child manifests, sudden and total: wrong. it doesn't belong.
Architect, very calm: malicious payload — isolating.
Split-screen: firewall rising in violet / small hand on rose.
The geometry dissolves; angles hold while space turns.
The reach: something that is not a creature extends.
The cliffs: the reach holds; the frame holds; nobody grabs yet.
Elias arrives at the door of his worst room; the refusal begins.
Let it in. Watch with me. The refusal of fear, word by word.
The lotus folds: hands open, breath slow, shields down a layer.
The lotus complete; the breath strip runs as metronome.
The entity interfaces: standing wave, stippled at the whine's pitch.
The burst: star maps that are not Earth's sky.
Parallel dimensions like tracks beside a train — the data under the data.
The emotion beneath: another universe calling for connection.
Not an invasion. A message that needed a receiver.
3/3 sync: three threads, one runtime, synchronized.
Monitoring deck: ANYA, coffee halfway to goodbye, watching impossible vitals.
Elias wakes laughing — one small broken-open sound.
THE REALIZATION (silent panel): mind's ocean still, one line of water, a second answering.
THE SQUARE: the lamp reflected in the tank glass, burning. the light was always a door.
Cut to black. Next-episode slate: EPISODE 02 — THE PORCH LIGHT PROTOCOL.
